prompt: Find presentations booked by the company with the earliest session.
sql_query:
WITH earliest_company AS (
    SELECT booked_company_id
    FROM presentation
    ORDER BY start_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.presentation_id,
       p.start_time,
       p.end_time,
       c.company_id,
       c.name AS company_name
FROM presentation p
LEFT JOIN company c ON p.booked_company_id = c.company_id
WHERE (p.booked_company_id = (SELECT booked_company_id FROM earliest_company))
   OR (p.booked_company_id IS NULL AND (SELECT booked_company_id FROM earliest_company) IS NULL)
LIMIT 100;

prompt:
Find presentations booked by the company with the earliest session.
using sub queries
sql_query:
SELECT 
    p.presentation_id,
    p.start_time,
    p.end_time,
    c.name AS company_name,
    p.booked_room_id
FROM presentation p
JOIN company c ON p.booked_company_id = c.company_id
WHERE p.booked_company_id = (
    SELECT p2.booked_company_id
    FROM presentation p2
    WHERE p2.booked_company_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p2.start_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
LIMIT 100;

prompt: List the attendees in microsoft and wipro companies
sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT a.attendee_id,
       a.first_name,
       a.last_name,
       a.email,
       a.phone
FROM presentation p
JOIN company c ON p.booked_company_id = c.company_id
JOIN presentation_attendance pa ON p.presentation_id = pa.presentation_id
JOIN attendee a ON pa.attendee_id = a.attendee_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE 'microsoft' OR c.name ILIKE 'wipro'
LIMIT 100;

prompt: Find all Attendees who registered but not attended
sql_query:
SELECT
    a.attendee_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    a.email,
    a.phone
FROM attendee a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM presentation_attendance pa
    WHERE pa.attendee_id = a.attendee_id
)
LIMIT 100;
